articles.title_en: Tree plantation for implementing the land utilization policies incorporate with sustainable development towards environmental concerns in Assam, India
articles.title_cn: 植树造林以实施土地利用政策，结合可持续发展，关注印度阿萨姆邦的环境问题
articles.abstract_en: Environmental scientists have been considering the best use of natural resources in recent years, and in order to maintain sustainability, the government can no longer manage these resources alone without the support of the local people. The study aimed to assess the effectiveness of tree plantations in the hillsides and wasteland for addressing sustainable environmental considerations and providing a framework for implementing land utilization policies incorporated with sustainable developmental work towards environmental concerns and priorities. In this continuous and progressive-centered participatory research, 300 participants voluntarily joined in two stages of fieldwork, planted 300 saplings, and nurtured them for approximately four years. Because of the tropical monsoon, the mountain climate with high temperatures, frequent heavy rains, and high humidity, as well as the ongoing efforts of the local peoples to care for the agro-forestry saplings, this tree plantation operation in the hillsides and wasteland was successful. The locals continued to care for the saplings even after the project was completed in order to find both immediate and long-term financial benefits. Nonetheless, participant feedback was gathered, and the skewed median centered data was analyzed using the non-parametric Mann-Whitney U-test to evaluate the working hypotheses. The findings showed that there were no significant differences in the opinion of the participants' with planting trees or their comprehension of using human potential for sustainable farming, land readjustment, and food management. It concluded that tree plantation could provide a framework for implementing land utilization policies to incorporate sustainable development towards environmental concerns and priorities in Assam, India.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来，环境科学家一直在考虑自然资源的最佳利用方式，为了维持可持续性，政府不能再单独管理这些资源，而没有当地人民的支持。本研究旨在评估在山坡和荒地上植树造林的有效性，以解决可持续环境问题，并为实施土地利用政策提供一个框架，该政策结合了可持续发展的努力，关注环境问题和优先事项。在这项持续且以进步为中心的参与式研究中，300名参与者自愿参加了两阶段的实地工作，种植了300棵树苗，并培育了大约四年。由于热带季风气候，山地气候高温、频繁暴雨和高湿度，以及当地人民持续努力照料农林业树苗，这次在山坡和荒地进行的植树造林活动取得了成功。即使在项目完成后，当地人继续照料树苗，以寻求即时和长期的财务收益。尽管如此，收集了参与者的反馈，并使用非参数Mann-Whitney U检验分析了偏斜中位数中心数据，以评估工作假设。研究结果显示，参与者对植树或对利用人类潜力进行可持续农业、土地整理和粮食管理的理解方面没有显著差异。结论是，植树造林可以为实施土地利用政策提供一个框架，以将可持续发展纳入印度阿萨姆邦的环境问题和优先事项中。

articles.title_en: Land tenure administration in Iraq: Quantitative analysis and a comprehensive evaluation
articles.title_cn: 伊拉克土地管理：定量分析与综合评价
articles.abstract_en: The present study underscores its novel methodology, employing a mathematical extrapolation as a guiding framework to investigate and scrutinize the Iraqi land tenancy system. Remarkably, this innovative approach stands distinct from preceding research endeavors. Notably, its application holds potential for facilitating a comprehensive inquiry into land tenure management facets across in Iraqi jurisdictions. Nevertheless, situated within a milieu characterized by volatility, an unfavorable investment climate, and a feeble private sector, the applicability of the policy's approach has been restricted. The land tenure sector has, regrettably, encountered challenges in assuming its anticipated role. Hence, a comprehensive investigation becomes imperative to evaluate plausible land tenure strategies and chart a prospective path forward for the nation a quest hitherto unexplored in extant scholarly works. To address this pressing issue, this paper endeavors to scrutinize and investigate successful interventions deployed by internal factors in response to predicaments akin to those presently challenging Iraqi system. In order to fulfill this objective, a set of negative interventions were used as indicators of the institutional aspects and how can elements of the existing system be assessed, thus the research methodology employed herein combines a numerical investigation of collected data derived from survey statistics with an exhaustive sample in Iraqi city, Al-Nasiriya. The outcomes of this investigation unveil the viability of endorsing enhancing the eroded trust in the Iraqi authorities, administrators of Iraqi land system have to add more details to the real picture of the existing system’ deficiency and then produce the effective solutions as a promising principal approach to be pursued within the contextual confines of Iraq.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究强调了其新颖的方法论，采用数学外推作为指导框架，以调查和审视伊拉克土地租赁制度。值得注意的是，这种创新方法有别于先前的研究工作。其应用有望促进对伊拉克各辖区土地管理方面的全面探究。然而，在动荡、投资环境不利和私营部门薄弱的环境中，该政策方法的适用性受到限制。遗憾的是，土地租赁部门在承担其预期角色方面遇到了挑战。因此，进行全面调查以评估可行的土地租赁策略并为国家规划前瞻性道路势在必行——这一探索在现有学术著作中尚未涉及。为解决这一紧迫问题，本文致力于审视和调查内部因素针对类似当前伊拉克系统所面临困境的成功干预措施。为实现这一目标，采用一系列负面干预作为制度方面的指标，并评估现有系统要素如何被评价，因此本文采用的研究方法结合了对调查统计数据收集数据的数值调查与伊拉克城市纳西里耶的详尽样本。调查结果揭示了支持增强伊拉克当局受损信任的可行性，伊拉克土地系统的管理者必须为现有系统缺陷的真实图景增添更多细节，然后提出有效解决方案，作为在伊拉克背景范围内应遵循的有前景的主要方法。

articles.title_en: The role of local officials in promoting public participation during local urban planning processes: Evidence from Chinese cities
articles.title_cn: 地方官员在地方城市规划过程中促进公众参与的作用：来自中国城市的证据
articles.abstract_en: Even though the importance of public participation in urban planning has been thoroughly discussed in European and North American planning circles, it is still a new topic in China. Top-down planning processes are dominant in China, yet local officials are empowered to determine the extent and nature of public participation during local planning processes. To date, few scholars have explored how local decision-makers use this authority or which elements factor into the strategies they choose. Our analysis of master plans from 129 of China’s county-level cities shows that the age, overseas education experiences, and professional experiences of local officials have a significant effect on their decisions related to promoting public participation during the planning process, while their education level, Party school experience, and political career experience do not. We conclude that older-age local officials with overseas study experience, or with a background in technology or academia, tend to have a greater interest in promoting public participation in the process of crafting local master plans. We finally conclude with three insights that aim to enhance public participation in urban planning and land use management policy making: (1) Increased international communications and specific empirical case studies of public participation for officials; (2) Standardization of public participation in the planning and management processes; and (3) Utilization of more user-friendly online resources to expand public involvement and highlight the potential benefits for officials.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管公众参与城市规划的重要性在欧洲和北美的规划界已被深入讨论，但在中国仍是一个新话题。自上而下的规划过程在中国占主导地位，但地方官员有权决定地方规划过程中公众参与的程度和性质。迄今为止，很少有学者探讨地方决策者如何使用这一权力，或者哪些因素影响他们选择的策略。我们对来自中国129个县级市的总体规划的分析表明，地方官员的年龄、海外教育经历和专业经历对其在规划过程中促进公众参与的相关决策有显著影响，而他们的教育水平、党校经历和政治职业经历则没有显著影响。我们得出结论，年龄较大、有海外学习经历或具有技术或学术背景的地方官员，往往更倾向于在制定地方总体规划的过程中促进公众参与。最后，我们提出三点见解，旨在增强城市规划中的公众参与和土地利用管理政策制定：（1）加强国际交流，为官员提供具体的公众参与实证案例研究；（2）在规划和管理过程中标准化公众参与；（3）利用更易于使用的在线资源扩大公众参与，并强调对官员的潜在益处。

articles.title_en: Current research and opinion on land governance for societal development in and on the global south
articles.title_cn: 全球南方土地治理促进社会发展的当前研究与观点
articles.abstract_en: The articles analysed and presented in this editorial are from the Special Issue (SI) entitled, Current Research and Opinion on Land Governance for Societal Development in and on the Global South, curated from an e-conference that brought together many diverse scholars and practitioners from across the global land community. These articles can become multi- inter- and cross-disciplinary reference material for in-class and on-field education and learning in land studies. Their knowledge base covers specific subjects on land use planning, urban development, land administration, land governance, land policy, rural development, land management, real estate, land tenure, property rights and gender and women concerns (to mention a few). All scholars within the land profession—whether in the business, geography, sociology, area studies, anthropology, planning, engineering and the built environment disciplines—are encouraged to read, use and apply this knowledge base in their distinct roles in the land sector or land-related activities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本社论分析和呈现的文章来自题为“全球南方土地治理促进社会发展的当前研究与观点”的特刊，该特刊源自一次电子会议，汇聚了来自全球土地界众多不同领域的学者和实践者。这些文章可以成为土地研究中课堂和实地教育与学习的多学科、跨学科和交叉学科参考材料。其知识基础涵盖土地利用规划、城市发展、土地管理、土地治理、土地政策、农村发展、土地管理、房地产、土地权属、产权以及性别和妇女关切等具体主题（仅举几例）。鼓励土地专业的所有学者——无论是在商业、地理学、社会学、区域研究、人类学、规划、工程和建筑环境学科——在土地部门或土地相关活动中发挥各自作用时，阅读、使用和应用这一知识基础。

articles.title_en: Finding the forgotten spaces: Using a social-ecological framework to map informal green space in Melbourne, Australia
articles.title_cn: 寻找被遗忘的空间：利用社会-生态框架绘制澳大利亚墨尔本的非正式绿色空间
articles.abstract_en: Informal green spaces (IGS) are the overlooked and unplanned green spaces in our cities. They have been shown provide a potentially important social and ecological green space asset through contributing to ecological habitat and connectivity, as well as green space accessibility for urban residents. Despite their potential value to urban social-ecological systems, IGS are often overlooked and forgotten in urban planning policy. However, before we can think about how best to govern these spaces, we must first know where they are. This paper proposes a method to spatially locate IGS in a practical and resource sensitive way. We outline a method that uses an overlay analysis of open government data to map IGS at a high resolution and at a landscape scale based on key social-ecological characteristics. The method was applied to a case study in the City of Darebin, Melbourne, Australia, and evaluated through an onsite validation process. Results indicate that the method accurately predicted the location of IGS within the urban environment with an accuracy of 83%. This mapping method has several useful applications both within the Melbourne and Australian contexts, as well as potential application globally. These include enabling future research into how IGS contribute to urban social-ecological systems, as well as enabling land use decision makers seeking to better understand the abundance and nature of IGS sites they manage and how they may govern these spaces in a more informed way.
articles.abstract_cn: 非正式绿色空间（IGS）是城市中被忽视和未经规划的绿色空间。研究表明，它们通过促进生态栖息地和连通性，以及为城市居民提供绿色空间可达性，可能成为重要的社会和生态绿色空间资产。尽管它们对城市社会-生态系统具有潜在价值，但IGS在城市规划政策中常常被忽视和遗忘。然而，在我们思考如何最好地管理这些空间之前，我们必须首先知道它们在哪里。本文提出了一种以实用且资源敏感的方式在空间上定位IGS的方法。我们概述了一种方法，该方法利用开放政府数据的叠加分析，基于关键的社会-生态特征，在高分辨率和景观尺度上绘制IGS地图。该方法应用于澳大利亚墨尔本达雷宾市的一个案例研究，并通过现场验证过程进行评估。结果表明，该方法准确预测了城市环境中IGS的位置，准确率为83%。这种绘图方法在墨尔本和澳大利亚背景下有几种有用的应用，也有在全球应用的潜力。这些应用包括促进未来研究IGS如何促进城市社会-生态系统，以及使土地利用决策者能够更好地了解他们管理的IGS地点的丰富性和性质，以及如何以更明智的方式管理这些空间。

articles.title_en: A European perspective on acceptability of innovative agri-environment-climate contract solutions
articles.title_cn: 欧洲视角下创新农业环境气候合同解决方案的可接受性
articles.abstract_en: The agri-environment-climate measures of the European Union Common Agricultural Policy are incentives aiming to reduce negative environmental impacts and increase positive effects generated from agriculture. Several criticisms have been addressed to their efficiency and effectiveness and thus, the design of innovative contract solutions is currently suggested. Among the novel contractual solutions, there are result-based payments, collective implementation of measures, the engagement of private and business actors in value chains, and new forms of land tenure systems coupled with environmental clauses. Little is known about the factors at interplay influencing farmers’ decision to uptake such contracts. The present paper investigates the acceptability determinants of the above-mentioned novel contractual solutions concerning a sample of nearly 1900 farmers from 10 European Union countries. The analysis is based on a questionnaire built through a common research framework. We apply ordered logistic regressions: both proportional and partial proportional odds models are used. Farmers’ preferences are interpreted by splitting the innovative contractual solutions into 13 individual contractual features which are then modeled in combination with the structural characteristics of the farms and the sociodemographic and behavioral characteristics of the farmers. We estimate farmers’ willingness to enroll in result-based, collective, value-chain, and land tenure contracts and highlight the positive and negative factors potentially influencing farmers’ acceptability of each type of contract.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟共同农业政策中的农业环境气候措施旨在减少农业产生的负面环境影响并增加正面效应。这些措施的有效性和效率受到了一些批评，因此目前提出了创新合同解决方案的设计。在新型合同解决方案中，有基于结果的支付、措施的集体实施、价值链中私人和商业行为者的参与，以及带有环境条款的新型土地保有权制度。关于影响农民接受此类合同决策的相互作用因素知之甚少。本文调查了上述新型合同解决方案在来自10个欧盟国家的近1900名农民样本中的可接受性决定因素。分析基于通过共同研究框架构建的问卷。我们应用有序逻辑回归：使用比例和部分比例优势模型。通过将创新合同解决方案分解为13个单独的合同特征，并与农场的结构特征以及农民的社会人口统计和行为特征相结合进行建模，来解释农民的偏好。我们估计了农民参与基于结果、集体、价值链和土地保有权合同的意愿，并强调了可能影响农民对每种合同类型可接受性的积极和消极因素。

articles.title_en: Araguaia biodiversity corridor cost benefit analysis: Large scale restoration and sustainable agribusiness in Amazon and Cerrado
articles.title_cn: 阿拉瓜亚生物多样性走廊成本效益分析：亚马逊和塞拉多的大规模恢复与可持续农业经营
articles.abstract_en: Ecosystem restoration is an important tool for reducing ecosystem loss and contribute to diminish the negative impacts from deriving from climate change, but can be very costly. This paper focuses on the cost-benefit and cost-effectiveness analysis of recovering almost one million hectares of legally protected areas in the Araguaia Biodiversity Corridor (Brazil) following the Brazilian Forest code regulation. We analyze two paths for recovery, ecological and economic (including timber and agroforestry systems). We consider the direct and indirect local costs, as well as monetized environmental benefits using the social cost of carbon and avoided soil erosion. According to our estimates, in 50 years, the recovery of the Araguaia Corridor will lead to net societal benefits with either the ecological (US$ 19.8 billion) or economic (US$ 18.9 billion) pathways in all macro-regions (north, central, and south) and rural property sizes (small, medium and large). The recovery captures 262 million tCO2eq and avoids 527 million tons of soil erosion with the economic path; these estimates are 23% and 1.7% higher, respectively, when using the ecological path. Importantly, we show that the restoration activity is not carbon credit dependent on being profitable when based on the economic path proposed. Additionally, this study highlights the high profitability of agroforestry systems, especially in small farms. There are also relevant local impacts, from 12 to 38 thousand new direct jobs. Even considering a limited menu of ecosystem services (carbon and soil), we show that social benefits from the Araguaia biodiversity corridor restoration exceed its social costs, justifying the subsidization of ecosystem restoration. In this sense, land use policies can incorporate mechanisms for financial support, grants, or incentives to encourage and facilitate ecosystem restoration efforts in the region.
articles.abstract_cn: 生态系统恢复是减少生态系统损失并有助于减轻气候变化负面影响的重要工具，但可能成本高昂。本文聚焦于巴西阿拉瓜亚生物多样性走廊（Brazil）根据巴西森林法规定恢复近一百万公顷法定保护区的成本效益和成本效果分析。我们分析了两种恢复路径，生态路径和经济路径（包括木材和农林复合系统）。我们考虑了直接和间接的当地成本，以及使用碳社会成本和避免土壤侵蚀的货币化环境效益。根据我们的估计，在50年内，阿拉瓜亚走廊的恢复将在所有宏观区域（北部、中部和南部）和农村财产规模（小、中、大）中通过生态路径（US$ 19.8 billion）或经济路径（US$ 18.9 billion）带来净社会效益。经济路径的恢复捕获了262 million tCO2eq并避免了527 million吨土壤侵蚀；这些估计在使用生态路径时分别高出23%和1.7%。重要的是，我们表明，基于所提出的经济路径，恢复活动并非依赖碳信用才能盈利。此外，本研究强调了农林复合系统的高盈利能力，尤其是在小农场中。还有相关的当地影响，从12到38 thousand个新的直接就业机会。即使考虑有限的生态系统服务菜单（碳和土壤），我们表明阿拉瓜亚生物多样性走廊恢复的社会效益超过其社会成本，证明了对生态系统恢复补贴的合理性。在这个意义上，土地利用政策可以纳入财政支持、赠款或激励机制的机制，以鼓励和促进该地区的生态系统恢复努力。
